title: The Hens and the Rat
lines: Ten hens live at the lake.
Jane and Pete give them rice.
At nine, the rice is gone!
The hens have not had a bite.
Pete finds a huge rat in the shed.
The rat has the rice in his hole.
Jane and Pete give the rat cake.
The rat naps in his hole.
At last the hens have rice.

questions.listenFor: The huge rat in the shed. If they are not sure, have them reread the line about the shed.

questions.ask: What do Jane and Pete give the rat?
questions.listenFor: A bit of cake. Listen for them seeing that the cake is a trade, so the rat leaves the rice alone.

questions.ask: Do you think it was fair to give the rat cake? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. You want a reason, like "yes, he was hungry too" or "no, he took the rice first."
